basic_details.job_title: NII Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

Candidates with M.Sc/M.Tech in Immunology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Microbiology or any other related field of Life Sciences can apply only through online mode by 14 November 2026. rows.details: National Institute of Immunology (NII), BRIC – a DBT Organization
"Towards developing gut microbial metabolites-based therapeutic intervention for colorectal cancer"

content_sections.heading: About NII Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Immunology is a research institute whose letterhead describes it as part of BRIC, a DBT Organization. This Project Assistant post is attached to a research project led by Dr. Anil Kumar, Staff Scientist-V, Gene Regulation Laboratory. The project, funded by ANRF, works towards developing a therapeutic intervention for colorectal cancer based on gut microbial metabolites.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Sc/M.Tech in Immunology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Microbiology or any other related field of Life Sciences from recognized university. Desirable: Research experience in molecular biology techniques. The notice does not print an age limit for the post. The application format asks whether the candidate has qualified any National Level Examination (such as NET/GATE), but the notice does not make it a condition to apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant will get Rs. 20,000/- per month plus 30% HRA, as per DST OM dated 10.07.2020/Funding agency norms. The position is for 06 months (six months) under the ANRF-funded project.

content_sections.heading: NII Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Candidates are desired to have experience in the field of molecular biology and cell culture techniques.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NII Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted only through online mode, up to 14 November 2026. The notice does not name a portal or a separate email address for sending the application; the only contact it prints is the Project Investigator's email ID, [email protected] . Fill up the application form in the prescribed format printed on page 2 of the notice. Attach your CV; applications without CVs are not entertained. Enclose the necessary documents for verification. Indicate the date of passing each examination clearly. Submit the application through online mode by 14 November 2026. Full name, father's name and mother's name Date of birth and age, gender, and category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/PH) Full correspondence address and permanent address E-mail ID, telephone number and mobile number Details of past experience and present employment, if any; whether holding an Overseas Citizenship of India (OCI) card (Yes/No) Whether qualified any National Level Examination (Yes/No), and academic qualifications: examination passed, year of passing, board/institution/university, percentage and division, remarks

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview will be conducted through online mode. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email of the date and the online link for the interview after the last date of applications. The notice lists the walk-in interview date as 17 November 2026 (Tuesday), online mode, 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Only registered candidates will be interviewed.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Apply strictly in the prescribed format; applications containing incomplete information will not be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NII Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one Project Assistant position only.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NII Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date for applying is 14 November 2026, and applications are accepted only through online mode.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NII Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need M.Sc/M.Tech in Immunology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Microbiology or any other related field of Life Sciences from recognized university; research experience in molecular biology techniques is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NII Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 20,000/- per month plus 30% HRA, as per DST OM dated 10.07.2020/Funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the NII Project Assistant pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 30% HRA is paid in addition to Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NII Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Fill up the application form in the prescribed format with your CV and the necessary documents for verification, and submit it through online mode by 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the NII Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email of the date and online link for the walk-in interview, which will be conducted in online mode; the notice lists 17 November 2026, 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the NII Project Assistant appointment?
faq.answer: The position is for 06 months (six months) under the ANRF-funded colorectal cancer project.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the NII Project Assistant interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
